hook_text: Phone went on the fridge. Then this.

song.title: Kitchen Party
song.style: English, groovy funk with slap bass, horn section, wah guitar, handclaps, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, party backing vocals, 110 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dinner for one and a glowing light
Same old noodles every night
Stuck my phone up on the fridge
Called my friends, they came in quick

[Chorus]
Kitchen party, pots and pans
Flour on our noses, clapping hands
Kitchen party, turn it up
Dancing round the coffee cups

shots.prompt: {moss} eats noodles alone at a small table at night, his face lit by a cold blue glow, a single noodle dangling sadly from his fork. Static medium shot. Dim blue light.
{moss} puts down his fork, frowns, and stands up with determination. Static close-up. Light warming.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
{moss} opens his front door and three friends burst in carrying bags of groceries and a guitar, cheering. Static wide shot. Warm hallway light.
{moss} and his friends chop vegetables and stir bubbling pots in a crowded little kitchen, laughing. The camera circles slowly. Warm golden light.
{moss} claps a ball of dough and flour puffs up into everyone's faces, and they all crack up. Static medium shot. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} claps along while a friend plays guitar on the kitchen counter. Static medium shot. Warm lamp light.
{moss} dances in the middle of the kitchen, spinning a friend around. The camera circles. Bright warm party light.
{moss} sits around a cluttered table with his friends late at night, everyone full and smiling, candles burning low. The camera slowly pulls back. Deep amber, calm.

endcard.line1: Phone on fridge. Feet on floor.

caption: Moss stuck his phone on the fridge in its Hibernator and the kitchen turned into a party. Flour everywhere. No regrets.
